features.text: PDAC APPROVED L4396/L4397: Static or dynamic orthosis available in off-the-shelf or custom-fitted models for therapy support.
FLEXIBLE INSERT SYSTEM: Allows up to 45° plantarflexion without heat molding for safe, personalized stretching.
PRESSURE-FREE HEEL DESIGN: Eliminates heel pressure points to prevent skin breakdown and improve comfort.
NON-SKID SAFETY BASE: Provides stable, slip-resistant traction for safer weight-bearing or assisted transfers.
CUSTOMIZABLE ELASTIC STRAPS: Adjustable tension bands offer controlled dorsiflexion and calf stretching during therapy.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Moderate to severe ankle and foot contractures
